desc: 冰蓝杂志风女装详情漏斗：穿搭氛围、领肩工艺、面料微距、四色与尺码收口
leaf: 蕾丝拼接V领短袖雪纺上衣
name: 蕾丝拼肩冰蓝清感短袖衫款

shots.intent: 首屏一秒给出上新氛围与主推利益，用杂志感大字和冰蓝底色把搜索点击接下来。
shots.textZone: 左上拉丁小标一行 + 左侧两行大标题 + 左下圆角信息卡，全部为占位文案

shots.intent: 用一正一侧的造型拼贴让买家想象自己的穿搭结果，建立百搭好穿的自我代入。
shots.textZone: 左上两行标题 + 右侧竖排小标 + 右下圆形标记，正文段落仅以占位排版出现

shots.intent: 把结构卖点和面料同屏讲清，用编号卡与图标带解释为什么值得多花预算。
shots.textZone: 右上编号标记 + 右侧色块内两行标题 + 图标下三枚短标签

shots.intent: 微距把轻薄、垂顺、亲肤的手感视觉化，用可拍的质感代替不可验证的成分宣称。
shots.textZone: 顶部留白带内一行短标题，其余无字

shots.intent: 同角度同光比的四色宫格让买家一步完成选色，减少尺码页之前的犹豫流失。
shots.textZone: 顶部居中小节标题 + 每卡下方一行色名占位标签

shots.intent: 侧身长度加规格表把合身疑问一次解决，数值全部留占位、避免虚标。
shots.textZone: 上半右侧两栏属性表 + 中部小节标题 + 下半四列四行尺码表 + 底部三行指数选项，数值一律占位

shots.intent: 用走线、包边和整件平铺的真实做工做信任收口，不借任何虚构资质。
shots.textZone: 左上一行短标题 + 底部三枚线性图标配短标签

shots.intent: 低角度全身拉出比例气势，用占位优惠与按钮完成最后一步下单动作。
shots.textZone: 左侧色块内两行主标题 + 一行优惠占位 + 右下圆角按钮

style.backgroundSystem: seamless ice-blue studio field #DCEBF5 alternating with clean white #FFFFFF infographic panels, one flat powder-blue #A9CBDE block and hairline charcoal rules for structure
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons inside plain circles, stroke-only, no filled or 3D icon sets, one {accent_color} underline bar per label
style.lightingSystem: bright high-key cool studio light, front-left softbox key at 5500-6000K, large white bounce fill, low-contrast soft shadows, one soft contact shadow grounding body and fabric edges
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium womenswear detail-page visual system across the entire set; editorial poster layout on a cool ice-blue studio field; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, ice-blue ground #DCEBF5, powder-panel blue #A9CBDE, coral accent #F39A98 and deep charcoal text #2D2D2D; cool high-key studio lighting, front-left softbox key at 5500-6000K with a large white bounce fill, low-contrast soft shadows and one soft contact shadow; large modern geometric sans-serif headlines paired with thin uppercase latin labels; thin single-weight line icons inside plain circles; rounded-corner image cards with generous white gutters and hairline rules; garment presented at a stable eye-level slight 3/4 or clean 90-degree side with consistent scale, natural drape and true fabric texture; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no warm sepia grade, no added graphics.
noDrift: no warm sepia or sunset grade
no brand marks, store badges, QR codes or member artwork
no invented numbers, prices, measurements, certificates or fibre origin claims
style.presentationRules: worn garment kept at a stable eye-level slight 3/4 or clean 90-degree side, generic model with face cropped above the chin, identical scale and angle across variant cards, flat-lay always squared to the frame, drape and surface texture rendered true
style.surfaceSystem: matte white lacquer board and pale stone-grey counter for flat-lay and macro screens, never glossy or reflective
style.typography: large modern geometric sans-serif Chinese headlines paired with thin uppercase latin eyebrow labels, deep charcoal #2D2D2D, one coral #F39A98 accent block per screen, short callouts only, dense body copy kept as clean placeholder text
